letter.company_line: Consultancy growing its VIC/TAS region and hiring 2027 civil and traffic graduates in Melbourne
letter.subject: 2027 Graduate Civil / Traffic Engineer, Melbourne
paragraphs: I am applying for the 2027 Graduate Civil / Traffic Engineer role in your Melbourne team, which I found on the WGA careers page. A graduate program that keeps hands-on design work at the centre is the kind of start I want.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Austroads guides and Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines, completed in 2019, so my most recent study is the Advanced Diploma.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer. I coordinated daily crews, reviewed drawings against project requirements, ran site inspections and quality checks, and kept progress reports for clients.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not used traffic modelling software such as SIDRA yet, and I am keen to learn it with your team. I've attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
